set -a; . /root/daily-call-audit/.env; set +a; python3 <<'PY'
import os, json, urllib.request
N8N_KEY = os.environ["N8N_API_KEY"]; N8N_BASE = os.environ["N8N_BASE_URL"]

cfg = {
    "workflow_id": "3oV7SpPKWmr3xJlQ",
    "filter_node": "Filter: call_analyzed",
    "create_node": "Create ClickUp Task",
    "dedup_branch": "Duplicate?",
    "junk_branch": "Drop Junk?",
}

def fetch(p):
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{N8N_BASE}/api/v1{p}", headers={"X-N8N-API-KEY": N8N_KEY})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode())

def execution_call_status(exec_id, cfg):
    data = fetch(f"/executions/{exec_id}?includeData=true")
    run = (data.get("data", {}).get("resultData", {}).get("runData", {}) or {})
    filt_runs = run.get(cfg["filter_node"]) or []
    if not filt_runs: return None
    main = filt_runs[0].get("data", {}).get("main", [])
    matched = main[0] if main and isinstance(main[0], list) else []
    if not matched: return None
    if cfg["create_node"] in run: return "created"
    if cfg["dedup_branch"] in run: return "deduped"
    if cfg.get("junk_branch") and cfg["junk_branch"] in run: return "dropped_junk"
    return "workflow_failed"

v = execution_call_status("19479", cfg)
print(f"verdict for Saturday exec 19479 (1-sec misdial): {v}")
assert v == "dropped_junk", f"expected dropped_junk, got {v}"
print("PASS — would no longer raise HIGH false-positive")
PY
